summary.text: Kobi Craddock is the Democratic candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 70, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He describes himself as a journeyman plumber and pipefitter and a small cattle producer from Ramsay.

paragraphs.text: Kobi Craddock said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a fifth-generation Montanan, a journeyman plumber and pipefitter, a union member and a small cattle producer from Ramsay, Montana, whose family's roots in southwest Montana date to 1884.
Craddock advanced from the Democratic primary for District 70 on June 2, 2026.
In the survey he said his campaign motto is "constituents first, party second, and Montana always."

He said he supports strengthening local food systems and protecting agricultural water rights, and that he would defend workers' rights, oppose right-to-work legislation and expand apprenticeship and vocational education.
